name: Which countertop material is best for durability and resale value?
description: Quartz and granite are best for durability and resale value. Quartz is non-porous and low maintenance; granite is heat-resistant and requires sealing.

mainEntity.name: Which countertop material is best for durability and resale value?

acceptedAnswer.text: For durability and strong resale value, quartz and granite are top contenders. Quartz countertops are engineered stone, highly durable, non-porous (stain-resistant), and require minimal maintenance. Granite is a natural stone known for its unique patterns, heat resistance, and long-lasting beauty; it does require periodic sealing. Both materials offer excellent longevity and are highly sought after by homebuyers, making them a wise investment for your kitchen. Other options like marble offer luxury but require more care.
